request: how does a thermostat keep a room at 20 degrees?

beats.intent: Axes of time and temperature with the target 20 °C drawn as a dashed line and a band from 19 to 21
beats.narration: The thermostat is set to twenty degrees. It allows the room to drift between nineteen and twenty one.
beats.code:
stage.title("A thermostat")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 60), y_range=(16, 24), labels=("minutes", "°C"))
target = DashedLine(ax.c2p(0, 20), ax.c2p(60, 20), color=GREY_B)
band = Polygon(ax.c2p(0, 19), ax.c2p(60, 19), ax.c2p(60, 21), ax.c2p(0, 21), stroke_width=0, fill_color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.15)
stage.play(Create(target), FadeIn(band))
stage.add(band, target)

beats.intent: A zigzag temperature line rising while the heater is on and falling while it is off
beats.narration: Below nineteen the heater switches on and the room warms. At twenty one it switches off and the room slowly cools.
beats.code:
pts = [(0, 17), (8, 21), (20, 19), (26, 21), (38, 19), (44, 21), (56, 19), (60, 20.3)]
temp = VMobject(color=ORANGE).set_points_as_corners([ax.c2p(*p) for p in pts])
stage.play(Create(temp), run_time=3)
stage.add(temp)

beats.intent: The rising stretches lit red and labelled 'heater on'
beats.narration: The heater is on only for the short warming stretches; most of the hour it is off.
beats.code:
ons = [((0, 17), (8, 21)), ((20, 19), (26, 21)), ((38, 19), (44, 21)), ((56, 19), (60, 20.3))]
segs = [Line(ax.c2p(*a), ax.c2p(*b), color=RED, stroke_width=7) for a, b in ons]
stage.play(*[Create(s) for s in segs])
stage.add(*segs)
stage.label(segs[1], "heater on", direction=UP, color=RED)
stage.caption("on for 24 of the 60 minutes")

request: how does vaccinating most people protect everyone?

beats.intent: A 10 by 10 grid of people, 19 of them immune in blue, one sick in red
beats.narration: Here are a hundred people. Nineteen are immune. One catches an illness that passes to neighbours.
beats.code:
stage.title("Herd immunity")
people = draw_dots(stage, n=100, cols=10, color=GREY_B)
immune = [2, 3, 11, 13, 15, 20, 21, 32, 48, 53, 55, 59, 61, 62, 66, 69, 88, 92, 96]
stage.play(*[people[k].animate.set_color(BLUE) for k in immune], people[44].animate.set_color(RED))

beats.intent: The red spreading through the grid until 78 people are sick
beats.narration: With so few immune, the illness finds a path almost everywhere: seventy eight people fall ill.

beats.intent: A new grid with 73 immune in blue: the red stops after 2 people
beats.narration: Now make seventy three of the hundred immune. The illness reaches one neighbour, then has nowhere to go.

beats.intent: Bars comparing 78 sick with 19 immune against 2 sick with 73 immune
beats.narration: Immunity protects the people who have it and the unprotected people walled in by them.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [78, 2], labels=["19 immune", "73 immune"], color=RED)
stage.caption("people who fell ill")

request: why does the supermarket queue keep growing?

beats.intent: A till drawn as a box with a row of customer dots waiting
beats.narration: Customers arrive at a till: three every minute. The cashier serves two every minute.
beats.code:
stage.title("A growing queue")
till = draw_rectangle(stage, width=1.2, height=1.0, color=GREY_B, fill=0.5)
till.move_to([4.5, 0, 0])
stage.label(till, "till", direction=UP)
line = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.18, color=YELLOW) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(LEFT, buff=0.3).next_to(till, LEFT, buff=0.4)
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(d) for d in line], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(line)

beats.intent: Three new dots joining the back and two leaving at the front, each minute
beats.narration: Each minute three join the back and two leave the front. The line grows by one every minute.
beats.code:
for minute in range(3):
    new = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.18, color=YELLOW) for _ in range(3)])
    for d in new:
        d.move_to(line[-1].get_center() + 0.66 * LEFT * (1 + list(new).index(d)))
    stage.play(FadeIn(new, shift=LEFT), run_time=0.5)
    line.add(*new)
    gone = VGroup(line[0], line[1])
    stage.play(FadeOut(gone, shift=RIGHT), run_time=0.4)
    line.remove(*gone)
    stage.play(line.animate.shift(0.66 * 2 * RIGHT), run_time=0.4)
stage.add(line)
stage.caption("3 in, 2 out: +1 a minute")

beats.intent: Axes of minutes and queue length with a straight line rising by 1 a minute
beats.narration: Plot it: the queue grows in a straight line, one person a minute, for as long as that lasts. Open a second till and it shrinks.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 30), y_range=(0, 35), labels=("minutes", "queue"))
g = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda t: 3 + t, color=YELLOW, label="3 in, 2 out")

request: how does a pulley make lifting easier?

beats.intent: A 100 N box hanging from one fixed pulley, pulled with 100 N
beats.narration: With one fixed pulley, you pull down with a hundred newtons to lift a hundred newton box. It only changes the direction.
beats.code:
stage.title("Pulleys")
beam = draw_line(stage, (-6, 2.6), (6, 2.6), color=GREY_B)
w1 = Circle(radius=0.4, color=WHITE).move_to([-3.5, 2.0, 0])
box1 = Square(0.9, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to([-3.9, -1.2, 0])
r1 = Line([-3.9, 2.0, 0], box1.get_top(), color=YELLOW)
r2 = Line([-3.1, 2.0, 0], [-3.1, -0.4, 0], color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(w1), FadeIn(box1), Create(r1), Create(r2))
stage.add(w1, box1, r1, r2)
stage.label(box1, "100 N", direction=DOWN, color=ORANGE)
pull1 = draw_arrow(stage, (-3.1, -0.4), (-3.1, -1.6), color=RED, label="100 N")

beats.intent: A second setup: the box on a moving pulley held by two ropes, pulled with 50 N
beats.narration: Hang the box on a moving pulley instead. Two ropes hold it up, so each carries half: you pull with fifty newtons.
beats.code:
w2 = Circle(radius=0.4, color=WHITE).move_to([3.0, -0.4, 0])
box2 = Square(0.9, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to([3.0, -1.6, 0])
hook = Line(w2.get_bottom(), box2.get_top(), color=GREY_B)
left = Line([2.6, 2.6, 0], [2.6, -0.4, 0], color=YELLOW)
right = Line([3.4, -0.4, 0], [3.4, 2.0, 0], color=YELLOW)
top_w = Circle(radius=0.3, color=WHITE).move_to([3.7, 2.0, 0])
down = Line([4.0, 2.0, 0], [4.0, 0.6, 0], color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(w2), FadeIn(box2), Create(hook), Create(left), Create(right), Create(top_w), Create(down))
stage.add(w2, box2, hook, left, right, top_w, down)
stage.label(box2, "100 N", direction=DOWN, color=ORANGE)
pull2 = draw_arrow(stage, (4.0, 0.6), (4.0, -0.4), color=RED, label="50 N")

beats.intent: The two setups beside 100 N ÷ 2 ropes = 50 N, rope pulled twice as far
beats.narration: The catch: to lift the box one metre, you pull two metres of rope. Half the force, twice the distance.
beats.code:
stage.equation(r"\frac{100\ \text{N}}{2} = 50\ \text{N}")
stage.caption("half the force, twice the rope")
